property.name: fs.defaultFS
property.description: Default filesystem URI. All hdfs:/// paths resolve to this NameNode.

property.name: hadoop.tmp.dir
property.description: Base directory for temporary Hadoop files (local disk on each node).

property.name: io.file.buffer.size
property.description: 128 KB stream buffer — tuned for high-throughput sequential text reads.

property.name: fs.trash.interval
property.description: Enable a 24-hour HDFS Trash to protect against accidental `hdfs dfs -rm`.

property.name: ha.zookeeper.quorum
property.description: ZooKeeper quorum used for NameNode automatic failover (HA).
